metadata.title: Neon Noir Portrait with Venetian Blind Shadows

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s studio portrait featuring a subject illuminated by blue gel light through Venetian blinds, paired with clean sans-serif and expressive script typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a male subject with textured, feathered hair, positioned against a dark background. The scene is dominated by a cool blue light source coming from the left, filtered through window blinds to create sharp diagonal shadow patterns across the face and background. The right side of the frame remains in deep shadow, creating a dramatic chiaroscuro effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal lines of the blinds contrasting with the organic curves of the face
Cool blue primary lighting against a pitch-black negative space
Sharp, clean sans-serif type intersecting with fluid, hand-drawn script
Vibrant red accent color popping against the monochromatic blue and black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, medium close-up, looking slightly over the shoulder toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's brightly lit blue eye on the left side of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal lines of the blinds lead the eye from the top-left down to the subject's face, then up to the typography in the top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the right side provides balance and room for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue highlights with extreme value contrast against deep blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: All-caps, italicized, high-waisted geometric sans-serif
Secondary text: Fluid, slanted brush script with long ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the primary text is often intersected by the script's long strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modernist geometric sans paired with expressive, organic handwriting for a 'tech-meets-human' 80s feel.

preserve: Color contrast between white and red text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, slanted brush script style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with 80s feathered hair, lit with intense blue light through Venetian blinds, creating diagonal shadows across the face and a black background on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase italicized white sans-serif text in the top right, and overlay a red slanted script font slightly below and overlapping the first line.

verificationChecks: Are the blind shadows diagonal and sharp?
Is the skin tone predominantly blue?
Does the red script overlap the white text?
Is the right side of the image deep black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue light doesn't wash out facial details
Verify the red script is legible against the black
Check that the blind shadows follow the facial contours
Confirm the sans-serif text is perfectly italicized
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Noir Portrait = (Blue Gel Lighting + Venetian Blind Gobo) + (Geometric Sans-Serif / Brush Script Overlay) + (High Contrast Chiaroscuro)
